summary: The guest opens connections of its own, to an echo server on the host that it reaches at the user network's gateway

cases.behavior: A UDP socket binds, finds nothing to read, sends to the host's echo server and receives the same bytes, refuses to receive into a kernel address, gets an echo of 8192 bytes back whole, and carries datagrams of the largest sizes over 127.0.0.1 and ::1, whole or cut to a short buffer

execution.cleanup: libetude-case stops the echo server and the machine

steps.does: start hostpeer echo on the case's port, until it is stopped
boot the test image to the debug shell
run udptest with the port at the debug shell and take its report from the console

services.does: echo what arrives over TCP and UDP on 127.0.0.1 at the case's port, which the guest reaches at 10.0.2.2

assertions.checks: the socket binds the local port
a MSG_DONTWAIT receive on the empty socket answers EAGAIN
the message sent to the echo server comes back with the same bytes
with the echo still queued, a receive into a kernel address answers EFAULT
a datagram of 8192 bytes sent to the echo server comes back with the same bytes, and ReasmOKs of /proc/net/snmp grows
a datagram of 65507 bytes sent to 127.0.0.1 arrives whole, with the same bytes
a send of 65508 bytes over IPv4 answers EMSGSIZE
recvmsg into 100 bytes of a datagram of 65507 returns 100, the first 100 bytes, with MSG_TRUNC in msg_flags; recvfrom with MSG_TRUNC returns 65507; and each takes its datagram
a datagram of 65527 bytes sent to ::1 arrives whole, with the same bytes, and a send of 65528 answers EMSGSIZE

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the echo server is the host's, reached at the gateway of QEMU's user network; tests/native/probes.cases runs udptest against a peer

cases.behavior: A TCP socket connects to the host's echo server, reads back what it wrote and closes with a FIN the server sees, and a connect to a closed port is refused

execution.cleanup: libetude-case stops the echo server and the machine

steps.does: start hostpeer echo on the case's port, until it is stopped
boot the test image to the debug shell
run tcptest with the port at the debug shell and take its report from the console
find the echo server's line that the guest closed its end, and stop the server

services.does: echo what arrives over TCP and UDP on 127.0.0.1 at the case's port, which the guest reaches at 10.0.2.2, and say when a peer closes its end

assertions.checks: a stream socket connects to the echo server
a 14-byte write is read back whole and equal
close of the connected socket returns 0
a connect to a closed port of the host is refused, and returns
the echo server reads the end of the stream that the guest's close sent

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended
